3. That all records of unrecognized guerrila units
disbanded in confomity herewith, together with any re-
quest for recognition and evidence in susport of such
request, be assembled and turned in to the Commander
of the nearest unit or the United States Army or of the
Army of the Philippines for forwarding to lisadquarters;
Philippine Army.
Done at the City of Manila, this 26th day of sey-
tember, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
forty-five, and or the Conmonwealth of the Philippines,
SERGIO USSIANA
President or the Philippines

to the President
